text: 武汉再推8条新政稳楼市，异地公积金贷款全面放开 主城区与远城区房价价差显著，新政有意缓解远城区的去化压力。
text_en: Wuhan Rolls Out 8 New Policies to Stabilize Housing Market, Fully Opens Cross-Region Provident Fund Loans; Significant Price Gap Between Main Urban and Distant Districts, New Policies Aim to Ease Destocking Pressure in Outer Areas.
